entries.title: Matthew 12:1
segments: At that time Jesus walked through the wheatfields one Sabbath Day; and his disciples were hungry, and began to pluck some ears of wheat and to eat them.

entries.title: Matthew 12:2
segments: But the Pharisees, when they perceived it, said to him: "Look! Your disciples are doing what it is not lawful to do on the Sabbath!"

entries.title: Matthew 12:3
segments: "Have you not read," answered Jesus, "what David did when he was hungry, and his men, too?

entries.title: Matthew 12:4
segments: "How he went into the House of God, and there they ate the loaves of the Presence, which neither he nor his men were permitted to eat, but the priests only?

entries.title: Matthew 12:5
segments: "Have you not read in the Law how on the Sabbath the priests in the Temple break the Sabbath and are guiltless?

entries.title: Matthew 12:6
segments: "But I tell you that One is here who is greater than the temple.

entries.title: Matthew 12:7
segments: "And if you knew what this means, "It is mercy I desire, not sacrifice,

entries.title: Matthew 12:8
segments: "you would not have condemned the guiltless. For the Son of man is Lord of the Sabbath."

entries.title: Matthew 12:9
segments: As he passed along he went into their synagogue, and there he saw a man with a withered hand.

entries.title: Matthew 12:10
segments: And in order to get a charge against him they asked him, "Is it permitted to heal on the Sabbath?" (So that they might have something to accuse him.)

entries.title: Matthew 12:11
segments: "Is there a man of you," he replied, "who has but a single sheep, who will not lay hold of it and lift it out, if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath Day?

entries.title: Matthew 12:12
segments: "And how much more is a man worth than a sheep? Therefore it is right to do good on the Sabbath."

entries.title: Matthew 12:13
segments: Then he said to the man, "Stretch out your hand."

entries.title: Matthew 12:14
segments: The man stretched it out, and it had become sound like the other. But when the Pharisees came out, they consulted together how they might destroy him.

entries.title: Matthew 12:15
segments: So when Jesus knew it, he withdrew from that place, and numbers of people followed him.

entries.title: Matthew 12:16
segments: He cured them all; but he strictly forbade them to blaze abroad his doings,

entries.title: Matthew 12:17
segments: that the word spoken through Isaiah, the prophet, might be fulfilled:

entries.title: Matthew 12:18
segments: Behold my servant whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom my soul delights; I will breathe my spirit upon him, and he shall announce justice to the Gentiles>

entries.title: Matthew 12:19
segments: He will not strive nor cry aloud, Nor shall anyone hear is voice in the streets>

entries.title: Matthew 12:20
segments: The bruised reed will not break; The dimly burning wick will not quench; Till he has led justice on to victory.

entries.title: Matthew 12:21
segments: And in his name shall the Gentiles hope.

entries.title: Matthew 12:22
segments: Then they brought to him a blind and deaf demoniac; and he healed him, so that the dumb both spoke and saw.

entries.title: Matthew 12:23
segments: And all the crowds were amazed, and he began to say, "Can this be the Son of David?"

entries.title: Matthew 12:24
segments: When the Pharisees heard it they said, "It is only by the aid of Beelzebub, the Prince of the demons, that this fellow is driving out demons."

entries.title: Matthew 12:25
segments: Because Jesus knew what was in their minds, he said to them: "Any kingdom divided against itself will become desolate; and any city or household divided against himself will not stand.

entries.title: Matthew 12:26
segments: "So if Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then will his kingdom stand?

entries.title: Matthew 12:27
segments: "And if I am casting out demons in the power of Beelzebub, in whose power do your sons cast them out? So they themselves shall be your judges.

entries.title: Matthew 12:28
segments: "But if it is in the power of the Spirit of God that I am casting out demons then the kingdom of God is already upon you.

entries.title: Matthew 12:29
segments: "Or how can any one enter the strong man's house and carry off his goods without first binding the strong man? Then he can rob his house.

entries.title: Matthew 12:30
segments: "He who is not with me is against me; and he who is not gathering with me, scatters.

entries.title: Matthew 12:31
segments: "Therefore I tell you that every sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven men; but the blasphemy against the Holy Spirit shall not be forgiven.

entries.title: Matthew 12:32
segments: "And if any man say a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, either in this age or in that which is to come.

entries.title: Matthew 12:33
segments: "Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for by its fruit the tree is known.

entries.title: Matthew 12:34
segments: "You generation of vipers! How can you speak good, when you are evil? For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.

entries.title: Matthew 12:35
segments: "A good man out of his good treasure brings forth good; and from his evil treasure a bad man brings out evil.

entries.title: Matthew 12:36
segments: "I tell you that for every careless word that men speak they shall give account on the day of judgment.

entries.title: Matthew 12:37
segments: "For by your words you will each be justified, and by your words be condemned."

entries.title: Matthew 12:38
segments: Then some of the Scribes and Pharisees accosted him. "Teacher," they said, "we want to see some sign from you."

entries.title: Matthew 12:39
segments: In reply Jesus told them: "An evil and faithless generation seeks a sign, and no sign will be given them except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

entries.title: Matthew 12:40
segments: "For just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the sea-monster's belly, so the Son of man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

entries.title: Matthew 12:41
segments: "The men of Nineveh will stand up in the Judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented under the preaching of Jonah, and lo! a greater than Jonah is here!

entries.title: Matthew 12:42
segments: "The Queen of the South will rise in the judgment with this generation, and condemn it, because she came from the ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon; and lo! a greater than Solomon is here!

entries.title: Matthew 12:43
segments: "Whenever an unclean spirit leaves a man, it wanders through waterless places, seeking rest but finding none.

entries.title: Matthew 12:44
segments: "Then it says, "'I will go back to my house which I left'; and on arrival finds it empty, swept, and garnished.

entries.title: Matthew 12:45
segments: "Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits worse than itself; and they enter in and dwell there. And the last state of that man is worse than the first. So shall it be with this wicked generation."

entries.title: Matthew 12:46
segments: While he was still talking to the crowd, his mother and brothers were standing outside, desiring to speak to him.

entries.title: Matthew 12:47
segments: So some one told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, and wanting to speak to you."

entries.title: Matthew 12:48
segments: But he answered the man who told him, "Who is my mother and who are my brothers?"

entries.title: Matthew 12:49
segments: And stretching his hand toward his disciples, he said,

entries.title: Matthew 12:50
segments: "Behold my mother and my brothers! For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven, is my brother and sister and mother."
